## Notes

- `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a `{{WAS:…}}` on the opening line of a `Release:` comment; put the reading in the body.
- A PR body edit through `issue_patch` needs the trailing `<!-- signed: … -->` line; `post-stamped --body` wants the signature first.
- A merge-conflict dequeue (#30551) was resolved by merging `origin/main` into the branch (no rebase), then a delta contract review on the new head and a fresh `automerge_enable`.
